about.title: Bilingual Excellence at the Service of Every Child
about.body: Founded in Nkozoa and accredited by the Ministry of Basic Education (MINEDUB), the Bilingual School Complex Les Génies d'Afrique welcomes children from 0 to 12 years in a bilingual, safe and stimulating environment. Our bilingual approach — French and English — prepares your children to succeed in a globalized world.
features: Safety and well-being at the heart of our mission

stats.title: Les Génies d'Afrique by the Numbers

programs.title: A Complete Journey from 0 to 12 Years
programs.subtitle: Each cycle is designed to develop your child's cognitive, linguistic and social skills.

items.title: Day Care
items.body: A safe and affectionate environment for toddlers. Sensory development, motor skills and first bilingual learning.

items.title: Nursery
items.body: Pre-Nursery and Nursery to build the foundations of learning in a joyful and caring environment.

items.title: French Primary
items.body: Official Cameroonian curriculum enhanced with progressive English immersion from Grade 1.

items.title: English Primary
items.body: Rigorous anglophone curriculum with French introduction, preparing students for the best secondary schools.

items.title: Bilingual from Day Care
items.body: Full French–English bilingual immersion from age 0, for a natural mastery of both languages.

items.title: Official MINEDUB Accreditation
items.body: National recognition, certified official curriculum, guaranteed teaching standards.

items.title: Unique Educational Projects
items.body: Farming, livestock, aquaculture, junior entrepreneurship: learning by doing from the earliest age.

items.title: Qualified & Passionate Teachers
items.body: Qualified teaching staff, ongoing professional development, attentive and personalised support.

items.title: Safety & Well-being
items.body: Secured premises, permanent supervision, child protection charter, a caring environment.

items.title: Learning by Doing
items.body: Active pedagogy, hands-on projects, developing the natural talent of every child.

items.name: Mrs. Ngo Biyong
items.text: Since my son enrolled at Les Génies d'Afrique, I have noticed remarkable progress. He now speaks fluently in both English and French. The support is exceptional.

items.name: Mr. Atangana Biyick
items.text: A school that combines academic rigour with personal development. My two children love coming to school every morning!

items.name: Mrs. Essomba
items.text: The farming and livestock projects truly surprised me. My daughter has developed a sense of responsibility and a love of work. Congratulations to the whole team!
